name: The Divine Deception
source:
Something's happening in Panthea... Most are blind to it, most go from day to day oblivious. But for those who can see farther, the winds of change are impossible to miss. The upcoming election has provided a surprising challenger against the incumbent Governor. The largest company in the city is going through a phase of corporate restructuring. The criminal underworld seems to be slowly collapsing in on itself. And all the while, a mysterious string of killings have begun to put everybody on their toes. There's a grand lie being told to everyone around, and if the truth isn't revealed soon, Panthea will end up in flames. Care to learn the truth? Read through The Divine Deception, and find out.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820720/The_Divine_Deception/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
潘西亚正在发生一些事情……大多数人对此视而不见，大多数人日复一日地健忘。但对于那些看得更远的人来说，变革之风是不可能错过的。即将到来的选举为现任总督带来了令人惊讶的挑战者。该市最大的公司正在经历公司重组阶段。犯罪黑社会似乎正在慢慢崩溃。与此同时，一连串神秘的杀戮开始让每个人都保持警惕。周围的每个人都被告知了一个弥天大谎，如果真相不尽快被揭露，潘西亚最终将陷入火焰。想要了解真相吗？通读《神圣的欺骗》，你就知道了。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820720/The_Divine_Deception/]Steam[/url]]
